Container.Name: Polyfin
Container.Overview:
Polyfin is a self-hosted, Jellyfin-compatible media server for Stremio addons. It is designed to let Jellyfin apps on TVs, phones and computers browse and play what your own addons provide, with multiple users and transcoding.
EARLY DEVELOPMENT: Polyfin is not ready for everyday use yet.
REQUIRED: A PostgreSQL 18 container must already be running, for example the official postgres:18 image with a dedicated database and user named polyfin. Enter its address in PostgreSQL URL as postgresql://USER:PASSWORD@HOST:5432/DATABASE, where HOST is the PostgreSQL container name on a shared custom Docker network or the Unraid server IP. Use a URL-safe password such as the output of openssl rand -hex 24. Polyfin waits for the database and creates its tables automatically.
FIRST RUN: open the container log and copy the one-time setup code, then open the WebUI and create the administrator with it.
GPU (optional): Polyfin converts video on the first GPU that works and logs which one. NVIDIA: install the Nvidia Driver plugin, add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters, and set NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES to the GPU's UUID or all. AMD or Intel: add --device=/dev/dri to Extra Parameters.
Polyfin hosts no content and ships with no addons or catalogues: you choose and configure your own sources. Do not forward its HTTP port to the internet.

Config.Name: HTTP port
Config.Description: Port for Jellyfin apps and the admin page. 8096 is the port Jellyfin apps try by default.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL URL
Config.Description: Connection URL of your PostgreSQL 18 database, for example postgresql://polyfin:YOUR_PASSWORD@postgres:5432/polyfin. Keep the password URL-safe.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: Amount of detail in the container log. Use debug only while troubleshooting.

Config.Name: Cache size
Config.Description: Disk space for parts of the files being read, for example 10GB or 512MiB. They are kept in Docker's storage and emptied when Polyfin starts: keep this below the free space of your Docker vDisk or directory.

Config.Name: GPU
Config.Description: GPU video is converted on: auto uses the first that works, NVIDIA then AMD or Intel; none converts on the processor.

Config.Name: NVIDIA GPUs
Config.Description: NVIDIA GPUs Polyfin may use, with --runtime=nvidia in Extra Parameters: all, or a GPU's UUID from the Nvidia Driver plugin.

Config.Name: NVIDIA capabilities
Config.Description: NVIDIA driver libraries the container gets. Video decoding and encoding need video; tone mapping HDR on the GPU needs graphics.

Config.Name: Recordings folder
Config.Description: Folder on the server Live TV recordings are written to. Leave empty to keep recording off.

Config.Name: Recordings folder in the container
Config.Description: Set it to /recordings, with a recordings folder above, to turn Live TV recording on. Leave empty to keep it off.
